answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold stops bulk fakes: each identity is a vertex needing 10 distinct counterparties each epoch. A newcomer locks 50 credits in a vault, paying 6 per handshake; its ember burns only on fresh counterparties. Auditors flag any cluster sharing one funder; borrowed edges burn both bonds. Forging 1,000 costs 1,000 x (50 + 60) = 110,000, losing 60,000 in fees to a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 60 once and keep their bond.
